name: 28168-visionchat-qwen3vl2b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1. One in-process vLLM engine, served through guidellm's vllm_python backend.
architecture: Qwen3VLForConditionalGeneration. Language side FP8 W8A8 (e4m3, dynamic activation scale): 28 layers, hidden 2048, 16 query / 8 KV heads, head_dim 128, vocab 151936. Vision side bf16: a 24-block ViT, hidden 1024, patch 16, spatial merge 2, native resolution. One 3.47 GB shard.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=128 — this commit's own default `max_num_seqs`, so admission is not the binding constraint — bounded at 8192 requests / 1800 s safety, warmup the first 25% and cooldown the last 10%, seed static 28168.
workload: guidellm synthetic, single turn, TWO data sources because `synthetic_image` emits only an image column: (1) `synthetic_text`, prompt EXACTLY 94 tokens and output EXACTLY 121, both pinned min == max, with `output_tokens` declared on THIS source only since it SUMS across sources; (2) `synthetic_image`, 512x512, one image per request, jpeg, quality 20, content noise, so every row's image is byte-distinct. Per request on the wire: 94 text + 256 image tokens in, 121 tokens out, plus the chat template.
purpose: A vision chat assistant answering short questions about single 512-pixel photos for 128 concurrent users on one GPU.
launch:
# The engine's command line. Built from the commit in `setupcard.md`; `env.yaml` says
# where that build lives here. Everything not listed is an engine default.
#
# THE YAML READER IS FLAT: it skips indented lines and JSON-parses any value beginning
# `{` or `[`. The one mapping-valued key below MUST stay inline on a single line -- if it
# is re-flowed the key is silently dropped and the engine starts without it at rc=0.

model: Qwen/Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct-FP8

# Forbids the video modality outright, so only the image path is ever exercised.
limit-mm-per-prompt: {"video": 0}

tensor-parallel-size: 1

# The worst case on the wire is under 400 prompt tokens plus 121 output. The checkpoint's
# own window is 262144, which would make the engine's startup profiling pass reserve KV
# this item never touches.
max-model-len: 4096
